description: Assignment-level activation receipt. One per assignment_ref. Proves the seat engaged with the Operating Law FOR THIS task, in its own words. Composes with (does not replace) NAYA-ACTIVATION/ACTIVATION-RECEIPT-TEMPLATE.json, which is session-level.

assignment_ref.description: The exact assignment this receipt is bound to (dispatch ID, issue/PR reference, or brief hash). One receipt per assignment_ref; not transferable.

mission_objective_own_words.description: The current mission objective stated fresh, in the seat's own words (2-4 sentences). Must NOT be identical to any canned mission string and must NOT be copied from the brief or a prior receipt.

operating_law_ref.description: Optional: ref of the Operating Law the seat loaded (e.g. 'naya4/operating-law-v1'). Recommended for audit trails.

proof_standard.description: What 'done and verified' looks like for THIS task, concretely: the named evidence (file, test, scorecard, screenshot, ref) the lane's proof bar requires. No named evidence = not a proof standard.

relevant_domains.description: Exactly 3 distinct Operating Law domains most relevant to THIS assignment, each with its task-specific reasoning.

domain.description: One of the 8 Operating Law domains (BRAIN/01-GOVERNANCE/0008-OPERATING-LAW-V1.md).

why_this_task.description: Why THIS domain for THIS task, in the seat's own words. MUST reference content-bearing terms from the actual assignment text (enforced by validate_receipt.py keyword-overlap check). Template the format, never the content.

seat.description: Seat identity, e.g. 'naya-3'. Must match the seat that performed Layer 1 boot.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of receipt emission, e.g. '2026-10-09T18:30:00-07:00'. Must be parseable; garbage timestamps fail closed.

title: Naya Activation Protocol Layer 2 — Engagement Receipt
